entityDescription: Geofem is a SME consultancy specializing in the fields of Satellite Remote Sensing and Geotechnical Engineering. This combination of specializations, allows us to offer unique services to our customers. Our remote sensing projects are mainly in Earth Observation and cover a wide range of fields: ground and infrastructure displacement monitoring, water resources management, atmospheric pollution, agriculture, change detection, disaster monitoring and resilience, soil subsidence etc. Our engineers have a thorough grounding in satellite image analysis techniques and radar image analysis. For our projects, we use specialized software. For our satellite remote sensing work, we use ENVI-SARscape, SNAP and GIS tools to perform optical and radar satellite analysis. For our geotechnical work we use Plaxis 2D and 3D finite element analysis software, as well as other support software, to perform designs and assessments of geotechnical structures. We specify and supervise site investigations and interpret the results to obtain appropriate input parameters for soil models. We also authored the popular NAFEMS guidebook "Obtaining parameters for geotechnical analysis". Geofem staff are performing an important role in the evolution of Eurocode 7, particularly to improve its use with numerical methods, and we are experienced in the implementation of Eurocode 7.

entityDescription: Alpha Impulsion was founded in late 2022 and patented hybrid autophage propulsion, a space launch vehicle architecture proposing to use a solid fuel as the launcher's fuselage and tank for its liquid oxidiser. This disruptive technology removes the need for tanks, which represent half the dry mass, enabling a single-stage-to-orbit trajectory. These simplifications will allow the company to propose the lowest environmental impact ever for a launch service in 2028 and reducing the cost of access to LEO by an order of magnitude. This will allow this European launcher to compete with advantages against the american leader that currently dominates the European smallsat launch market. Alpha Impulsion will provide dedicated launches for smallsats up to 1000kg, evolving towards reutilization capability before 2035 to further improve the launch capacity. In April 2023, the company started developing Ambre, the first autophage rocket, and fired the engine for the first time in January 2024. Most ground tests were done at the present date (10/24), enabling a static fire at the end of the year and an atmospheric flight in early 2025. Going forward from this proof of concept, this technological breakthrough requires a 3-year R&D roadmap on the propulsion system and launcher architecture, which Alpha Impulsion is leading with an increasing number of European partners, being implanted in France and Italy to develop the architecture axis where the required skills are, and working towards a larger scale engine prototype with the University of Glasgow, one of the leading research bodies in autophage propulsion. The technology is also appliable to in-space propulsion for high energy missions (orbit raising, deorbitating, inter-planetary missions) and Alpha Impulsion is starting a line of development for a prototype system with Thales Alenia Space as the prime user.

description: Riskaware deliver actionable intelligence through the seamless integration of science and software. Calirad is a company founded in 2022 and based in Zagreb, Croatia. Calirad specializes in robotics and IoT systems development and is co-founded by Juraj Peršić, a Ph.D. holder in robotics, and Marin Vuković, an associate professor in electrical engineering with expertise in cybersecurity and IoT, who is also a rally race driver and organizer.
The main product that Calirad develops is an alarm system for rally race spectators in dangerous places, named RallyCam. When a potential hazard is detected using Calirad’s multi-sensor system mounted in a competitor vehicle, an alarm is broadcasted using both public and private network infrastructure. In addition to internal product development, Calirad also provides R&D services in both hardware and software robotics/IoT development, specializing in multi-sensor (camera, lidar, radar, IMU, etc.) calibration and fusion, with application to object detection and tracking, localization and mapping.

entityDescription:
Design & Data GmbH is a privately owned company located in Cologne and Braunschweig, Germany. It is recognized as a leading provider of crossmedia services to the Aerospace and Science sectors. Design & Data has been operating for 6 years in providing crossmedia support to the European Space Agency (ESA), the European Southern Observatory (ESO), EUMETSAT, the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) and the German Space Agency (DLR). 

In 2014 Design & Data won several awards for their video and crossmedia productions such as DLR’s web site to mark the 10th anniversary of Mars Express and the Rosetta mission campaign for ESA. The Rosetta mission, which culminated in the landing of the space probe Philae on comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko, received major publicity and media coverage. To date our Rosetta Cartoon videos have been watched over 600.000 times on the ESA YouTube channel.

Below is a list of the awards won by Design & Data GmbH: 
- Silver Communicator Award 2014: 10th anniversary Mars Express web site for DLR
- Gold Communicator Award 2014: Rosetta mission campaign video “#WakeUpRosetta – Once upon a time…” 
- Gold W3 Award 2014: Rosetta mission campaign video: “#WakeUpRosetta – Once upon a time…” 
- FastForward Science web video competition (2nd Place #Scitainment): Rosetta mission campaign video: “Rosetta - Fabulous fables and tales of tails”

In addition Design & Data has taken a leading role in contributing towards the creation of a European entrepreneurial space sector with a thriving start-up community. In April 2015 Design & Data co-organized the 1st European Startup Weekend Space, a business hackathon event that brought 80 participants from 18 countries to Bremen and turned the event into a Silicon Valley style Makerspace of innovation. The event generated 27 pitches, 11 business concepts of which 3 have been awarded with prizes. Our long-term goal is to create an interdisciplinary ecosystem of entrepreneurship driven innovation to Europe's space sector.

Please consult our web page for references to our work:
http://www.designdata.de

entityDescription:
Pangea Aerospace is a company dedicated to providing advanced chemical propulsion systems for the space industry, from the Newton to the Mega Newton, based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. Our disruptive propulsion technology is aimed at increasing profitability for our clients, such as launch service providers, launcher manufacturers or satellite operators.
The range of products developed by Pangea Aerospace utilizes green propellants and provides higher performance compared to existing solutions on the market. 
In space propulsion devices run on HTP and kerosen. Thanks to their modular design, they are highly scalable, ranging from 1 N to the hundreds of N, and they enable plug-and-play functionality for versatile maneuvering.
On the other hand, our rocket engines, also modularly designed, range from a few hundred N to 1 MN, offering the best performance-to-cost ratio, thanks to Methalox-powered reusable aerospike technology. The technologies we have already mastered and the expertise we've gained pave the way to offer, as well, in the short term, a wide spectrum of solutions for high-thrust propulsion

The company specializes in providing advanced industrial IT solutions, consulting, and advisory services across various industries, including chemicals and power generation. Below is a detailed overview of their expertise:
Entity Description
- Comprehensive Services: Hyperion offers a wide range of services, including process automation and control, supply of specialized control engineering equipment, and the development of bespoke AI-based control software.

- Project Management: The company excels in project management for power generation and other industrial sectors. Notably, Hyperion has been actively involved in the EUROASIA Interconnector project, a significant multi-million euro initiative aimed at connecting the electricity grids of Greece, Israel, and Cyprus, in collaboration with Nexans and GSI. Hyperion also supports Nexans by coordinating efforts and maintaining effective communication between all stakeholders involved in the project - see (1).

entityDescription: Maiolini Space Solutions is a small medium enterprise specializing in electronics and telecommunications engineering services. The company's engineers have wide domain experience in constellation design, satellite communication systems, space networks, and digital signal processing algorithms, with several years of experience in academia and industry. In collaboration with leading companies in the industry, its personnel have been involved in several ESA projects. Currently, its engineers are working in the designing, assessing, and implementing state-of-the-art algorithms for handover, data routing, and radio resource management in VLEO broadband constellations, the design of a VLEO constellation for persistent regional coverage and seamless terrestrial/non-terrestrial integration of 6G user terminals, and contributing to the space and ground segment systems engineering of private SSA constellations, including the design of the security and cryptographic architecture of services and satellites.

entityDescription:
LABORMET DUE , in Turin, is one of the most solid commercial structures in Northern Italy in the sector of scientific instruments for laboratories and quality controls. The added value of the services offered consists in the experience and professionalism acquired over the years, offering solutions tailored to the needs of customers, with the aim of solving problems related to the control of incoming materials, production control and, more generally, quality improvement processes. Labormet Due deals with the main characterization and measurement techniques: metallography , optical and electronic microscopy , image analysis , physical and mechanical tests , environmental simulation tests , chemical analysis , metrology in the research, production and quality sectors. For each supply, LABORMET DUE is able to guarantee the installation service , staff training , after-sales assistance , updates and certifications . The company's main activity is the marketing of control and measurement instruments and related consumables for the control of metal , ferrous and non-ferrous materials, plastic , rubber and composite fibres.

In addition to being able to supply the instruments, Labormet Dueoffers industrial computerized tomography services : reverse engineering , porosity evaluation, internal defect verification , dimensional analysis , are some examples of the use of this technology. Since the purchase of this instrument involves significant management and logistical costs and burdens, Labormet Due has chosen to offer this type of service since 2013, equipping itself with the best technologies on the market. Actually we have 3 CT scan from 300 to 450 kV. We have our own quality system management Certified ISO 9001 and EN 9100
